sentences.text: This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:

ORDER This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.124/2023 registered at Police Station-Misrod,
District-Bhopal (MP) for the offence under Sections 354, 354(A)(1)(i), 506, 511, 376, 354(A)(1) of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 14.09.2023.
Applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that applicant is father of prosecutrix aged about 66 years.
Prosecutrix is married daughter and she was having dispute with her husband, therefore, she was living in house of applicant.
She was claiming interest on the part of the house in which she was living, therefore, she has given notice to the applicant.
Applicant does not want to give the share in the house to his daughter/prosecutrix.
Property was self acquired and to put pressure on applicant, she lodged false complaint of rape against the him.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that this is a case where allegation is made by daughter against applicant.
There is no likelihood that she will falsely implicate her father.

In statement recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
direct allegations were made against applicant that he has committed rape on her.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5 .
Applicant is in jail since 14.09.2023.
Applicant is an old man aged about 66 years.
His custodial investigation is over and he is sent in jail.
There is civil dispute between father and daughter.
She is residing in house of applicant.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and also the age of applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application stands allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
(VISHAL DHAGAT)
